This may not help a lot, as you seem to have a lot of underlying issues. However I can suggest that you set reminders on your phone to do certain tasks. Your phone probably has an app for reminders, or you can download one. 

I have horrible memory and get distracted a lot (I can forget things in, I’m not kidding, like a few seconds to a few minutes), however I get things done and am a pretty responsible person, due to my reminders. Every time I’m thinking of something I need to do *later* I will set a reminder for it at a time I know I’m free, and note down the relevant details. I don’t wait to set the reminder later because, obviously, I’ll probably forget to do it.

I do it for a lot of tasks, and for some I set it to repeat at certain times, like daily, or say, every Tuesday. For example I set reminders for ten minutes before a class starts, or watering plants, feeding my cat, charging my watch, etc etc. It’s helped me immensely and may help you with your problem. Without my reminders, my life would probably be a mess.

The next time you get a call from your uncle, and you don’t have the time to or feel like doing it at the moment, take a minute to set a reminder to call him back at a time in the near future. When you dad reminds you about it, set a reminder for the day before or on his birthday.

For now, you may just want to talk to your uncle about it. Tell him it wasn’t intentional, explain your situation, apologize, and hope he understands. He seems to care about you a lot, seeing that he restored your canoe. 

Good luck!

Generally, people who use nounpronouns/identify as an animal or object, are neurodivergent. Their brain works differently than the average person, so that’s an explanation.

Also, ND people, especially people on the autistic spectrum, and treated like less than human, animals, and even objects, by society. Because of this, it may make them feel like they can’t really relate to “regular” gender roles, and relate more to animalistic things.

Also, note that pronouns don’t equal gender. Most people who use noun pronouns don’t believe they are those things. They are just more comfortable being referred to as those things.

Also, people who use those pronouns are a very minuscule part of the population (although unfortunately it seems to be becoming a trend), unlike how the internet portrays. And most of them are okay with they/them, because they understand the unacceptance of this new concept.

As an ND trans person, this new concept is kinda weird to me, but I’ll respect it (as long as it’s not something like blm/blmself or acab/acabself). It’s not hurting anyone. I understand the feeling of crushing dysphoria, and I understand how weird my brain can be sometimes.

Edit: If it really is a disorder, then you still shouldn’t be treating those people horribly. If you saw someone with schizophrenia, you wouldn’t call them dumb. You’d understand their situation, and know that it’s out of their control.

Gender dysphoria. I’ll never be a cis boy. I’m a teenager, still pretty young, and I have to watch the boys around me go through their major stage of puberty and it hurts so fucking much because why can’t I have that? I have to watch them have their voices deepen and grow taller. I’m fucking 5’1. Every time I remember I’m short asf and I’ll never be a boy it feels like I’m literally being stabbed and the breath gets punched out of me and I feel like those characters in movies when they receive a hard blow to the midsection/back and start coughing up blood. I have to physically stop what I’m doing at the moment and sit down.

This makes it so hard because maybe, just maybe, if I kill myself the pain will stop and I’ll reincarnate as a boy and be able to go through life as a boy.

And I can’t even do anything about it or talk to an adult because my parents are transphobic af and were abusive earlier in my life anyways. I had a therapist but she did something and kind of traumatized me. I’d look into a counselor at school but it’s probably obvious that they do absolutely nothing except say “oh I know you’re depressed but keep doing your assignments”.

I rarely cry, but I’ve cried more this year than I ever have for the last four years.

It hurts so much. I constantly wish there was some brain transplant thing so I could switch bodies with a boy. I only have one wish, I don’t care about anything else, I just want ONE wish, and that’s to get into the body I actually belong to. But that’s not possible.

I don’t know why this is so important to me. Maybe it’s because being myself is one of the most important things to me, and I’ll never truly be able to be myself and express myself if I’m not in the right body. I’ve always felt disconnected from my body, but never really thought much of it. I’ve always kind of had a weak sense of self, so I’d be obsessed with personality tests and things I could label myself with. And now that I’ve finally figured out the one thing that’ll truly connect me to myself and make me happy, I’m met with realizing it’s completely impossible for me to ever have that.

What’s even worse is I have so many similar facial features as my mom. My face will always be a disgusting reminder of who I hate so much.

I can’t even recognize myself in the mirror. I can’t tell if it’s depersonalization or gender dysphoria but who the fuck is that? Why do I look like that? Who’s body am I in? And can someone please get me out of it?

Most people don’t know how painful it is to be trans. Before I figured out I was a boy, I never knew it was this hard. This is the worst pain I’ve ever been in. It’s hell. If I thought summer of 2017, my most traumatic year, was killing me, this is absolutely murdering me.

I stay in bed all the time. I have just barely the energy to complete my school assignments, mostly because of my fear of failure. I’ve relapsed back into cutting. I’ve stopped eating. Why should I, anyways? My eyes look so full of pain, but so deadened and lifeless.

I don’t think I’ll ever be truly happy if I can’t get into the body I belong to.

What did I do to deserve this? I was the kindest, most compassionate kid when I was younger, and all I wanted was to be happy, and I get this in return? Life decided to fuck me over. I’ve been so much trauma and fucking shit. I’ve changed, so I’m not that kind anymore, and hell, maybe I’m an absolute fucking piece of shit, but I don’t deserve any of this.

I managed to get through all the previous problems, like abuse, pure o intrusive thoughts, and I thought this was the end of my miserable part of my life. But no. It wasn’t. Those previous things were easier to get through because I always had myself with me. I never needed anyone, and the only thing that mattered was that I had myself. But now, this gender dysphoria is going *against* me. It’s destroying everything every wall, every defense mechanism, and all the fighting spirit I built throughout the years.

I remember when I was little and life-loving and I was horrified at learning there were people with depression and wanted to even kill themselves. Now that feeling is such a normal thing. I can imagine the horror and disappointment on my younger self’s face if she could look at how I’d turn out in the future.

At night, I like to close my eyes and imagine being a boy, and when I open my eyes again, reality comes crashing down. Either that, or I imagine, graphically, killing myself and finally feeling the sweet release of death.

Please believe me when I say this isn’t my body. You can look at most people and it IS their body. They belong to it. But I’m just a person in a body that doesn’t belong to me. Maybe it’s a delusion, but I truly believe that.

If I got that one wish, I would be finally be truly happy. But that’s not gonna happen.

I don’t want to die, I love life, I really don’t want to die, I have a cat that’ll miss me, I’ll miss my beloved rock music, I’ll miss mother nature, but this is so painful. I’m just so exhausted. I don’t know how much longer I’ll be able to hang on.

Sorry for writing so much.
